Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are walking out to the middle. Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz are the openers for Afghanistan. Dilshan Madushanka to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Now the target should be chased quite easily from Afghanistan. Yes, the wicket is not the easiest but maybe 130 would have been competitive. Lanka on the other hand, need wickets and a lot of them earlier on. Can they pull off a miracle?

The damage was done early on by the pacers, especially Fazalhaq Farooqi who took two in one over. Then there was a good partnership between Bhanuka Rajapaksa and Danushka Gunathilaka which seemed like taking Sri Lanka to safer shores but once the latter fell, it was a procession. Mujeeb Ur Rahman then along with Mohammad Nabi weaved their magic. The killer blow was Rajapkasha's run out which really killed Lanka’s chances of getting to a competitive total. Overall, it was quite a poor show from the Lankans in the opener.
Thanks to Karunaratne, Sri Lanka have gotten over the 100-run mark but it is Afghanistan who will be the happier of the two sides after a tremendous performance with the ball.

OUT! TIMBER! Fazalhaq Farooqi gets his third wicket and that is it for the Sri Lankan innings. He comes 'round the wicket and serves this on a yorker length, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne stays there and tries to go big on the off side, but only manages and inside edge and the ball goes onto rattle the stumps. A good effort from Karunaratne to take Sri Lanka past the 100-run mark. Sri Lanka finishes on 105 runs.
A slower one, short and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne heaves it towards the deep mid-wicket region where the fielder covers the ground well and cuts it out. Two runs taken!
A high full toss, on leg, Chamika Karunaratne lofts it towards long on for no run. It was there to be put away.
FOUR! Stand and deliver! This is full and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne smashes it over the bowler's head for a boundary. 100 up for Sri Lanka!
Who will bowl the last over? It will be Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Yorker and down the leg side, Dilshan Madushanka looks to play at it but misses. The ball hits his pads. A loud appeal but the finger stays down. Afghanistan go upstairs. Ball Tracking shows that it was pitching outside leg. Close call!
On a length and outside off, Chamika Karunaratne lofts it to long off. The fielder pouches it. They take one. The catch won't count as it was a free hit.
NO BALL AND A FOUR! A high full toss above waist height, on leg, Chamika Karunaratne pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. Free hit coming up..
Shorter one on middle, Chamika Karunaratne gently pulls it to square leg for a brace. He stays on strike.
Another dot as this is played at covers.
Fuller and on off, Chamika Karunaratne flicks it to mid-wicket. Another dot.
Fuller and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne hits it straight down the ground. Dot.
Naveen-ul-Haq (2-0-15-1) comes back into the attack.

Fuller one on leg, Chamika Karunaratne looks to play at it but gets his pads and rolls on the surface. They scamper through for a quick single. The keeper makes an attempt for run out but misses the stumps. Close!
Play and a miss. Shorter and on off, Chamika Karunaratne looks to pull it but misses.
Fuller and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne drills it down the ground for a brace. He stays on strike.
Fuller one this time, Chamika Karunaratne drills it to long on. He doesn't take one. Another dot!
Another one outside off, Chamika Karunaratne knocks it to long off but stays on the creae. Dot.
Slower one, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne knocks it to mid off but doesn't take one.
Full and on the leg stump, Chamika Karunaratne flicks it through square leg for a single.

SIX! A tough chance in the deep but it ends up being a maximum. This is floated, full and on leg, Chamika Karunaratne lofts it in the air towards the deep mid-wicket fence. Naveen-ul-Haq there runs to his right towards the ball, but misjudges it and parries it over the ropes for a biggie. This is turning out to be good over for Sri Lanka.
Shorter and outside off, Chamika Karunaratne cuts it towards deep point. Another dot!
Fires this one outside off, Chamika Karunaratne smashes it towards long off but again refuses for the single.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne heaves it towards deep mid-wicket but denies for the run.

FOUR! A welcome boundary for Sri Lanka! This is darted down the leg side, Chamika Karunaratne helps it past the short fine leg fielder for a boundary. The fielder should have done better there and Mujeeb is not happy with him.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes back into the attack.
Flatter and shorter, on middle and leg, Chamika Karunaratne punches it through covers for a single and keeps the strike.
Floated around middle, Chamika Karunaratne uses his feet and knocks this towards mid-wicket of his inner half.
Rashid Khan continues with the googlies, on middle, turning in, Chamika Karunaratne looks to block but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Another googly, lands full and on middle, turning in, Chamika Karunaratne makes room to cut it but gets an inside edge onto the ground and towards short fine leg.
Darts this one on a yorker length, on middle, Chamika Karunaratne digs it to the leg side.
A googly, short and on off, turning in sharply, Dilshan Madushanka stays there and pushes it towards point and gets off the mark.
Dilshan Madushanka is the last man in for Sri Lanka.

OUT! CAUGHT!  Another one bites the dust! Leg cutter here, fuller in length, Matheesha Pathirana looks for the slog sweep but miscues it up in the air and a simple catch for Najibullah Zadran at point. Matheesha Pathirana makes his way back into the dressing room and Sri Lanka are now 9 down.
Commentary.Howout: c Najibullah Zadran b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: Outside off and fuller in length, Matheesha Pathirana eases it towards short third man. Dot.
Fuller and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne flicks it to backward square leg for one.
Tossed up, outside off, Chamika Karunaratne drives it but finds the fielder at covers.
Fuller again, Matheesha Pathirana works it to mid-wicket for one.
On off, defended.

NOT OUT! This one lands fuller and on off which nips back in, Chamika Karunaratne looks to block it but misses. Afghanistan go upstairs. Ball Tracking shows that it was pitching outside off and the bails were hitting. They go with umpires' call. Close!
Outside off this time, Matheesha Pathirana looks to slog sweep it but doesn't connect well. The ball rolls towards the leg side. They collect one.
Flatter and on off, defended.
Fuller and on leg, Matheesha Pathirana flicks it to backward square leg for a brace.
Tossed up around middle, Matheesha Pathirana blocks it out.
Floated, full and on off, Matheesha Pathirana looks to defend it but has no idea where the ball is moving and misses.
Fires this one, full and on middle, Matheesha Pathirana guides it with his outer half towards point for one.
Nabi is bowling outswingers at the moment, this again short and on off, shaping away, Matheesha Pathirana gets beaten on his outside edge.
Tossed up, on middle, turning away, Matheesha Pathirana looks to block it but misses.
Matheesha Pathirana comes out to the middle.

RUN OUT! Another miscommunication! Fuller one around off, Chamika drives it towards cover and calls for one.The fielder throws it towards the keeper and he does the rest. The decision is taken upstairs and replay shows that he was outside the crease. Another one bites the dust and Sri Lanka are eight down now!
Maheesh Theekshana comes out to the middle.

RUN OUT! Oh, what has happened here? This one lands fuller and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne flicks it towards the leg side and takes one. There is a slight misfield and the batters decide to take another run. Mohammad Nabi makes a direct hit and Rajapaksa has sold himself down the river here. That was a suicide from Rajapaksa.
Slightly shorter with a hint of turn, Chamika Karunaratne looks to cut it but misses.
Again quicker but this time turns the other way, on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa gets cramped but manages to knock it towards point.
A googly now, quicker and outside off, turning away sharply, Bhanuka Rajapaksa goes for the heave on the off side but cannot connect.
Looped up, full and on middle, turning away a bit, Bhanuka Rajapaksa blocks it out.
Darts in yorker length delivery, on middle, Chamika Karunaratne digs it towars short mid-wicket for a quick single.
Tossed up, full and on leg, Bhanuka Rajapaksa sweeps it through square leg for one.
Flatter and around middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa pushes it towards short third man and sets of for the run, but his partner denies and rightly so. He makes his ground in time.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne defends it down the pitch. Another brilliant over for Afghanistan.
Flighted and around off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa guides it towards short third man for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Chamika Karunaratne drives it down to long on for a single and gets off the mark.
Angled in, on middle, knocked back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on off, Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to covers.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new batter.

OUT! TAKEN! The break does the trick for Afghanistan! Mohammad Nabi gets his first wicket. He bowls this quicker, shorter and around off, Dasun Shanaka stays there and looks to guide it away to the off side, but gets a thin outside edge. The keeper, Rahmanullah Gurbaz takes a brilliant catch behind the stumps moving to his right. Sri Lanka in huge, huge trouble now.
Commentary.Howout: c Rahmanullah Gurbaz b Mohammad Nabi

Commentary.Commentary: Drinks! Not the start Sri Lanka would have dreamed of and now it all depends on the likes of Bhanuka Rajapaksa and their skipper Dasun Shanaka. Afghanistan should be pleased with what their bowlers have delivered so far and would hope them to continue the same. Mohammad Nabi comes to bowl.
End of another brilliant over from Mujeeb! The last ball is pushed through. It is outside off. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to cut but is beaten.
On middle, defended.
FOUR! Cut hard! Bhanuka Rajapaksa just needs someone to stay with him there! This is shorter and outside off, he cuts it hard past point and this one races away to the fence.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to cover.
Dasun Shanaka walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is such a poor stroke at this moment of the game! Over 10 overs to go, the team is already 4 down, not sure if that was a good idea. He got away looking to play a slog sweep in the last over but this time falls. It is the one which spins away by Mujeeb. It is on middle, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to go over mid-wicket with the slog sweep again but this goes off the top edge towards mid off. Mohammad Nabi runs in and takes a good catch. Half the side back in the hut for Lanka. They need a big partnership again. They need the next pair to play for around 5 or maybe 6 overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nabi b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa works it through mid-wicket for one.
The slider to end! Outside off, shorter in length. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to cut but misses.
Almost! This is tossed up nicely, around off, it seems the googly. Wanindu Hasaranga looks to go for the slog sweep but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Almost! The leg spinner, it is shortish and just outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to cut but chops it, it bounces and goes over the keeper for two.
WIDE! Another extra! Down the leg side, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to sweep but misses.
On middle, this is pushed down to long on for one.
The idea was right but he just could not find the gap! Shorter and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga goes back and looks to guide it past point, tries to use the pace but fails to beat the fielder.
Rashid Khan comes into the attack now.
FOUR! Cut away! Shorter and outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa cuts it behind point and this one races away to the fence. The last ball spoils the over a little but still a brilliant one.
Wanindu Hasaranga is off the mark! Shorter and outside off, he chops it through point for one.
Shorter and outside off, Wanindu Hasaranga looks to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce.
On middle, Wanindu Hasaranga works it to mid-wicket.
Wanindu Hasaranga walks in.

OUT! TAKEN! This time Karim Janat hangs on and Afghanistan manage to break the stand which was going so well. They are back on top! Danushka Gunathilaka can feel a little unlucky here. He had hit that well but straight to the only man outside the ring on the off side. He brings out the reverse sweep. Mujeeb Ur Rahman bowls it around leg. Danushka Gunathilaka drags it from there but hits it uppishly towards Janat at sweeper cover who takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Karim Janat b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and on middle, defended.

REVIEW TIME! An appeal for a caught behind is turned down, it has been signaled as a wide! Rahmanullah Gurbaz wants it to be reviewed and it is taken! NOT OUT! This is fired down the leg side. Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to sweep but misses. A huge appeal after Gurbaz takes it but the umpire shakes his head. There is a spike but it is as the ball hits the pad. The wide has to be cancelled.
FOUR! Up and over cover! Wonderful stroke again! This is tossed up outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa lifts it over cover and this one races away to the fence.
Another quick single! Flatter and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka guides it towards point and gets tto the other end.
On the pad, this is clipped to short fine leg for a quick run!
On middle, kept out.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Wided.
This is shorter and on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it down to long off for one.
Mohammad Nabi brings himself into the attack.

FOUR! Thumped away! 20 from the over and Sri Lanka have recovered well after those three early wickets. They are 41 for 3 after the first 6. This is short and on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa pulls it over mid-wicket and this one races away to the fence.
FOUR! That is outstanding timing! Wonderful! Fuller and on middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa clips it over mid-wicket and this one races away to the fence.

DROPPED! That should have been taken, that should have been taken! Would have been a timely wicket as the momentum just seems to be shifting here! This is shorter and outside off, it is slapped but towards cover where the fielder, Karim Janat spills it. One taken.
FOUR! Thumped! Runs flowing now! Danushka Gunathilaka makes room, this is short and outside off, he slaps it past cover for a boundary.
WIDE! Pressure getting to Azmatullah Omarzai! He bangs it short but it is well wide outside off. Left alone. Wided.
FOUR! Innovation and it pays off! Danushka Gunathilaka does play these shots well. He looks to play the paddle scoop, this is on middle, he connects well and bags a boundary in the fine leg region.
That surely deserved more than a run! Short and outside off, this is cut hard, it goes towards deep point where there is a fielder and a run is taken.
WIDE! An extra to begin with! Short and down the leg side, Bhanuka Rajapaksa looks to pull but misses.
Azmatullah Omarzai comes into the attack now.
Tidy from Mujeeb Ur Rahman to begin with! Angled into middle, Bhanuka Rajapaksa flicks it through square leg for one.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa wanted a wide but not given! This is very short outside off, Bhanuka Rajapaksa was aiming to go leg side but then looks to cut but misses.
Shorter and on middle, this is pushed down to long on for one more.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Angled into the pads, this is worked towards fine leg for one.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes into the attack.

FOUR! That is caressed and that is a huge over for the Lankans! One they needed and it could well shift the momentum. This is a half volley, full and outside off, it is brilliantly driven through covers and it races away to the fence.
Good rotation of the strike again! On a length around off, this is guided to short third man for one.
Better! Not sure why that slower ball was bowled! Goes seam on again and on a length. Defended.

SIX! Over the fence and Sri Lanka will hope that breaks the shackles. Much, much-needed for them. Just the extention of the arms. Fuller and on off, a slower one. This is lofted over the long off fence for a biggie.
Fuller and on middle, Danushka Gunathilaka jams it out towards mid off for a run. Singles are very important when boundaries are hard to come by.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
A maiden by Fazalhaq Farooqi! Brilliant! Length and on middle, a slower one. Defended.
Almost chops it on! Shorter and outside off, Danushka Gunathilaka looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length and on off, Danushka Gunathilaka pushes it to covers.
Brilliant stuff! Just giving nothing away! Length and on middle, defended.
That one was hit well! Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
What a hat-trick delivery that is! Outstanding. This is full and it tails back in from outside off. Danushka Gunathilaka somehow gets his front leg out of the way and jams it out on the off side.
Bhanuka Rajapaksa walks in.

ANOTHER APPEAL! This time for a caught behind and the finger goes up. Pathum Nissanka reviews after a chat with his partner. OUT! Ultra Edge shows the slightest of spikes and it is ruled in the favor of the bowler. The Lankans are just not happy about this decision. They surely do not agree here. The decision could have gone either way. There was the slightest of spikes and it seemed like it was present throughout the process. Afghanistan won't care though as they have another one. This is full and outside off, Pathum Nissanka moves away and swings, it goes off something. The keeper takes it and appeals. The finger is raised. Afghanistan all over Sri Lanka.
Two! A slower one, that holds in the surface after landing. Pathum Nissanka steps out and looks to pull, it goes more off the underedge through mid-wicket for two.
Good length and on off, defended. Another dot.
Fuller and on off, Pathum Nissanka pushes it to covers.
Gets away with one there! On the pads, Pathum Nissanka looks to flick but misses, it hits the pad and goes to the left of the keeper who dives and stops it.
Good length and on off, defended. It will be intersting to see how Lanka go about things now.
Danushka Gunathilaka walks in. Naveen-ul-Haq to bowl from other end.

OUT! LBW! That is plumb, absolutely plumb in front! What an over, two in two for Fazalhaq Farooqi and this is a gem of a delivery. Charith Asalanka would have been watching from inside, most of the balls were shaping in to the right hander. He would have thought, Fazalhaq Farooqi will take it away but he does the opposite. He bowls a big booming inswinger to the left hander. Comes back in late from well outside off and also skids through after landing on a length. Charith Asalanka fails to put bat to it and is hit on the pad. A huge appeal and the finger is raised. Dreadful start for the Lankans.
Charith Asalanka is the new batter.

A HUGE APPEAL FOR LBW BUT TURNED DOWN! Afghanistan review! OUT! THREE REDS! Afghanistan strike in the very first over and that is a top, top review. That looked close first up, looked out actually. The inswing totally did Mendis in there. That is the ideal strike for Afghanistan! This is a lovely delivery. He gets it to shape back in from around off and middle and that to late. Mendis looks to pull across the line but misses and gets hit on the pad.
Very well timed! Seems like a good wicket so far! Length and on off, Mendis plays it late, times it well but finds point.
Got the last two deliveries to come back in, this time shapes it away, well wide outside off. Left alone.

That is a really good shot to get off the mark for Mendis! Fuller and on middle, tailing back in. He thumps it down the ground. Mid off gives it a chase, the outfield seems slow, he slides and pushes it back in. Two runs.
Some swing for Fazalhaq Farooqi! The line though is a little too straight. Pathum Nissanka works it through square leg and he along with Sri Lanka get off the mark with a single.

We are all set for the contest to begin. The players line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Afghanistan's first followed by the national anthem of Sri Lanka. Right then, It will be Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis who will start with their blades for Sri Lanka. Fazalhaq Farooqi comes to bowl. Here we go..

Styris says it is a new surface. Informs the boundaries are quite even, 66m is the shortest. Reckons it should be a good wicket for both batting and bowling and dew can be a factor later on. Adds the spinners might not get a lot of turn but good bounce but the batters should love the wicket.

Wanindu Hasaranga is up for a chat. He says that he will try to do his best for the team. Adds that they have a young team but they have the quality. Says this tournament is a good opportunity to perform for their youngsters. Ends by saying this tournament is important for them before going to the World Cup.

Rashid Khan is up for a chat. He says that The Hundred has been a great journey for him and he is happy to play for his team. Adds that they will be better and this Asia cup and its a good opportunity for them to learn from their mistakes. Says that the more they play the better they get and the Asia cup is a great opportunity for them.

Dasun Shanaka the skipper of Sri Lanka says they would have bowled first too. Informs they are playing with six batters, a couple of all-rounders and three bowlers. Ends by saying Madushanka and Pathirana are in the team.

Mohammad Nabi the skipper of Afghanistan says they will bowl first. He says it is a fresh pitch and not much cricket has happened in Dubai and they want to take a chance and restrict Sri Lanka to a low total. Adds that all three spinners are playing.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Ibrahim Zadran, Karim Janat, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi (C), Rashid Khan, Azmatullah Omarzai, Naveen-ul-Haq, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Danushka Gunathilaka, Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Charith Asalanka, Bhanuka Rajapaksa, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Dilshan Madushanka, Matheesha Pathirana.
TOSS - Afghanistan have won the toss and elected to BOWL first.

Afghanistan on the other hand, have superstars of this format in their side. Courtesy of their bowling attack, they can well be considered as an extremely dangerous opponent. Their batting though is not quite reliable. If both departments do click, they can be dangerous opponents. They enter this tournament on the back of a series defeat against Ireland but here, in familiar conditions, they’ll be a lot more confident. Toss and team news in a bit.
